label: inspired creativity
note: The next thing the colonist makes that has a quality is two levels better than its roll, so a masterwork roll is legendary. Used up by that craft.

label: inspired surgery
note: The next tend keeps its medicine (we have no surgery yet; RimWorld's inspired surgery cannot fail and uses nothing up). Used up by that tend.

label: inspired trade
note: Prices are better while it lasts. The stat is read by trading when it exists (TradeRules).

label: inspired recruitment
note: The warden's next recruit attempt has twice the chance. Used up by that attempt.

label: shooting frenzy
note: Shots spread 30% less and the gun cools down a third faster while it lasts.
